decisions.reason: The NFT-attribute impact is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY requiring randomly allocated no-referral commissions to appear in NFT attributes.
The ticket impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY covering randomly allocated no-referral tickets on the leaderboard and in NFT attributes.
The source concerns visibility of commissions and tickets, not referral-count accounting.
The source does not change how public referral counts or Top Referrals values must be calculated.
Reward visibility does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear in the dashboard inventory.
The source concerns missing reward attributes rather than NFT image or media rendering.
The source does not change completed-mint counts, mint numbering, or their data source.
Visibility of awarded commissions and tickets does not change the prize-draw countdown or its calculation.
The source does not alter the prize-pool balance statistic or its underlying data source.
The runtime visibility issue does not logically require a change to the existing explanatory FAQ content.
The source says no-referral commissions are being sent and identifies only a display problem; it neither changes allocation rules nor resolves the first-mint recipient ambiguity.
The source concerns randomly allocated no-referral commissions, not commissions paid to the holder whose referral code was used.
